title: Prescription of Interests for Non-Official Members

content.scenario: The State Government of Gujarat wants to constitute a State Council with non-official members representing various interests. It must prescribe the interests that these non-official members will represent.
content.outcome: The State Government of Gujarat will prescribe the interests that the non-official members of the State Council will represent, as required by law. These interests will be specified by the State Government, and the non-official members will be selected based on their representation of these interests.

user_queries: What is the procedure for selecting non-official members of the State Council?
How does the State Government prescribe the interests for non-official members?
What is the role of non-official members in the State Council?
